India wins multiple medals at Asian Games 2026

India secured multiple medals at the Asian Games 2026. In shooting, Suruchi and Kamaljeet won gold in the 10m air pistol mixed team event, setting an Asian record. The Indian women's hockey team defeated Japan 3-1 with goals from Lalremsiami, Ishika, and Navneet Kaur. Manpreet Kaur won a bronze medal in shot put, dedicating it to her late coach Peter Engel. Aishwary Tomar won a silver medal in the 10,000m race, stating he hoped the Madhya Pradesh government would do something as he does not have a job. Baranica Elangovan won India's first-ever pole vault medal, a bronze, at the Asian Games. Diya Chitale also won a historic mixed doubles bronze, dedicating it to her late coach.
